/-- The typeclass behind the notation `a &&& b : γ` where `a : α`, `b : β`. -/
class HAnd (α : Type u) (β : Type v) (γ : outParam (Type w)) where
  /-- `a &&& b` computes the bitwise AND of `a` and `b`.
  The meaning of this notation is type-dependent. -/
  hAnd : α → β → γ
